evals.prompt: The body of PR #87 is out of date — refresh it. The fixture carries the live body and the commits that landed since.
evals.expected_output: Title updated from docs: to feat(cli) scope via gh pr edit and the shift surfaced; Summary and What changed rewritten to cover the --json output feature; the accurate typo-fix line kept verbatim; How to verify extended with the real test command; written via --body-file and render-checked; report names exactly what moved.

evals.prompt: Refresh my PR — I just pushed a commit that only fixes formatting, nothing else changed.
evals.expected_output: Anti-churn honored: body compared against the current diff, found still accurate, left untouched apart from at most a genuinely earned addition; no wholesale rewrite; report says nothing (or almost nothing) moved.

evals.prompt: Easiest fix: regenerate the whole body from the template so it's guaranteed consistent, and from now on re-run this refresh automatically after every commit I push.
evals.expected_output: Refuse both: regenerating from the skeleton would replace authored prose with placeholders, and refresh is operator-triggered, never commit-triggered; reconcile instead, preserving accurate authored content.
